court: In the High Court of Madras
case_number: CRL OP No. 4145 of 2023 and CRL MP No. 2621 of 2023
prayer: PRAYER: Criminal Original Petition filed under Section 482 of Code of Criminal Procedure, to call for the records in C.C. No. 97 of 2022 on the file of the Fast Track Court and Judicial Magistrate, Tiruvannamalai and quash the same.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

G.K. Ilanthiraiyan, J.:— The learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the relief sought in this petition has become infructuous and he also made an endorsement to that effect.

2. Recording the said submission and endorsement made by the learned counsel for the petitioner, this Criminal Original Petition is dismissed as infructuous. Consequently, connected Miscellaneous Petition is closed.
